interactions.target_raw: Megakaryocyte and platelet inhibitory receptor G6b
interactions.note: The epitope of 17-4 Fab on the ectodomain of G6b-B was determined from the crystal structure of a ternary complex of the ectodomain of G6b-B bound to the heparin oligosaccharide dp12, scaffolded by a G6b-B-specific Fab fragment. The G6b-B construct used contained mutations N32D, S67A, S68A, S69A, T71A to remove potential N- and O-linked glycosylation sites.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.13 angstroms
